sessions.phase_label: Research corrections and operational workflow setup
Dropshipping catalog and Airbnb outreach operations
Refined outreach and AI-assisted content production

requirements.title: CRM Structure Document
requirements.definition: Create the requested CRM structure deliverable in the designated document.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the CRM structure artifact itself, not Google-folder handoff logistics or routine status reporting.

requirements.title: Pinterest Competitor Research
requirements.definition: Produce the Pinterest Task 1 competitor-research deliverable, including the requested profiles, supporting information, and links.
requirements.boundary_note: Additional profiles and required links are parts of one research artifact; the unspecified Pinterest Task 2 is not merged into it.

requirements.title: Outreach Tools Research
requirements.definition: Research useful tools that could make the outreach workflow easier.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a distinct research deliverable, not the Airbnb outreach execution or lead-recording workflow.

requirements.title: CJ Dropshipping Product Selection
requirements.definition: Research and select suitable trending products available through CJ Dropshipping using the client-approved evidence criteria.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns product discovery and selection criteria; publishing to TikTok Shop or Shopify and recording catalog data are independently testable sibling Requirements.

requirements.title: TikTok Shop Product Listing
requirements.definition: Publish each selected CJ Dropshipping product as a complete TikTok Shop listing.
requirements.boundary_note: Kept separate because TikTok listing can fail independently while Shopify listing succeeds; spreadsheet tracking is also a separate artifact.

requirements.title: Product Catalog Tracking Spreadsheet
requirements.definition: Maintain the product spreadsheet with required listing information and distinguish TikTok Shop records from website records.
requirements.boundary_note: The spreadsheet is an independently reviewable data artifact rather than an attribute of either publishing channel.

requirements.title: Daily Product Processing Batch
requirements.definition: Complete the required daily quantity of products through the product-selection and listing workflow.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns the recurring cross-workflow quantity acceptance criterion only; research, channel publication, and spreadsheet correctness remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Interested Airbnb Lead Tracking
requirements.definition: Use the outreach spreadsheet to record only Airbnb hosts or other prospects who respond and indicate interest in moving forward.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns spreadsheet eligibility and organization; initial outreach and the stricter HubSpot-entry threshold can change independently.

requirements.title: Airbnb Partnership Scheduling
requirements.definition: Coordinate a suitable visit or content date with Airbnb hosts who want to proceed, within the applicable partnership window.
requirements.boundary_note: Scheduling is a later independently actionable partnership stage, distinct from sending outreach and recording an interested response.

requirements.title: Secured Lead Entry in HubSpot
requirements.definition: Add an Airbnb host or other lead to HubSpot only after the partnership or scheduling arrangement is completely secured.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns HubSpot admission and data-entry timing; the spreadsheet retains earlier-stage interested prospects.

requirements.title: Social Content Bank
requirements.definition: Create and maintain the Google-based content bank containing reusable social-content material.
requirements.boundary_note: The content bank is an independently reviewable data artifact; scheduling and publishing posts from it are separate behaviors.

requirements.title: Daily Social Post Scheduling and Publishing
requirements.definition: Use the content bank to schedule and publish social posts daily once the required application access is available.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers recurring scheduling and publication, not account-access transfer or creation of the underlying content-bank artifact.

requirements.title: Blue Ridge AI-Assisted Social Content
requirements.definition: Generate the requested set of Blue Ridge Access social posts using approved examples and AI-assisted content-generation tools.
requirements.boundary_note: Blue Ridge automotive content has distinct subject matter and acceptance facts from Coastal Bazaar Picks travel and shopping content.

requirements.title: Coastal Bazaar Picks TikTok Content
requirements.definition: Generate Coastal Bazaar Picks TikTok content using Creator Search Insights, AI Canvas, suitable visual formats, brand-specific recommendations, and engagement calls to action.
requirements.boundary_note: The TikTok research-and-generation workflow is independently testable and should not be merged with Blue Ridge automotive posts merely because both use AI tools.

requirements.title: Blue Ridge Mobile Diagnostic Pricing
requirements.definition: Represent the approved Blue Ridge mobile-diagnostic base price, applicable additional fees, and inclusion of printed diagnostic codes accurately.
requirements.boundary_note: Pricing and package-inclusion facts form one service offer; public contact channels can change independently and remain a sibling Requirement.

requirements.title: Blue Ridge Public Contact Channels
requirements.definition: Use the approved Blue Ridge website and telephone channel, including text messaging for price inquiries, in customer-facing outreach and content.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers public customer-contact information only; the uncertain future email is not treated as established, and credentials are excluded.

requirements.title: Shopify Product Listing
requirements.definition: Publish selected CJ Dropshipping products on the Coastal Bazaar Picks Shopify website and maintain the required product category.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns website publication and categorization; TikTok publication has a separate execution path and failure trajectory.

requirements.title: Shopify Product Categorization
requirements.boundary_note: Changed by consistency audit.

requirements.title: Airbnb Host Outreach Message Delivery
requirements.definition: Contact Airbnb hosts across the target areas using the approved outreach approach and continue efficiently through candidate properties.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers sending the initial host outreach; tracking interested hosts, coordinating dates, and entering secured prospects in HubSpot are separate workflow stages.

requirements.title: Airbnb Host Selection
requirements.boundary_note: Changed by consistency audit.

requirements.title: HubSpot Contact Property Configuration
requirements.definition: Configure the required HubSpot contact properties and form fields needed to create complete lead records.
requirements.boundary_note: Changed by consistency audit.

1\. Open TikTok
Go to Creator Search Insights.

Search keywords related to CoastalBazaarPicks, such as:
Malaysian products
Malaysia shopping
Malaysian skincare
Malaysia markets
Malaysian food
Malaysia travel
Malaysian products to resell
Things to buy in Malaysia
3\. Look for Opportunities
Find topics with strong search interest or a Content Gap.
Choose a topic that fits CoastalBazaarPicks.
4\. Open AI Canvas
Use the topic you found and go to AI Canvas.
Type what you want to create.
For example:
“Create a TikTok post about 5 Malaysian skincare products people should know about.”
Use AI Canvas to help generate the post idea, structure, and content.

Turn the idea into your TikTok format:
Slideshow
Product photos
Text on each slide
Quick facts
Faceless video
Shopping footage
Product clips
Market footage
Text overlays
Talking video
Explain the topic
Give recommendations
Answer the question

Creator Search Insights already provides things like:
Recommended keywords
Search terms
Hashtags
Caption suggestions
Search-related information

Your recommendation
Product opinions
Malaysia shopping tips
Sourcing information
Restaurant recommendations
